storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Kajabi DL makes it easy to download videos from your Kajabi courses, memberships, and coaching programs.

How it works: Open any Kajabi lesson or page with a video, press play on the video, then click the extension icon. The extension automatically detects which platform is hosting the video (Loom, Vimeo, YouTube, or Wistia), shows the available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

Each embedded video platform gets its own detection and download handler, so the extension reliably finds and saves videos regardless of how the course creator hosted them. HLS-to-MP4 conversion happens in your browser — no external tools or command-line knowledge required.

Key features:
- Multi-platform detection — automatically identifies Loom, Vimeo, YouTube, and Wistia embeds on Kajabi pages
- Quality selection for each platform's available resolutions
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Concurrent download support (up to 3 simultaneous downloads)
- In-page download manager with real-time progress, speed, and cancel controls
- Cross-tab download synchronization
- yt-dlp command helper for YouTube videos
- Dark-themed popup with Kajabi red accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Open a Kajabi lesson or page with a video
3. Press play on the video
4. Click the extension icon, select quality, and download

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video from Kajabi?
faq.answer: Open a Kajabi lesson page with a video and press play. Then click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the video platform and shows available quality options. Select your quality and click Download.

faq.question: Which video platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The extension detects videos hosted on Loom, Vimeo, YouTube, and Wistia. These are the most common video hosting platforms used in Kajabi courses.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: Quality depends on the hosting platform and how the course creator uploaded the video. The extension shows all available quality levels for each video.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Can I download multiple videos at once?
faq.answer: Yes — the extension supports up to 3 concurrent downloads with an in-page download manager showing progress for each.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on custom Kajabi domains?
faq.answer: Yes — the extension works on *.kajabi.com, *.mykajabi.com, and custom domains that use Kajabi's platform.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the video player to load before it can detect the hosting platform. If issues persist, refresh the page and try again.

faq.question: Is this legal?
faq.answer: This extension is intended for downloading content you own or have purchased access to. Users are responsible for ensuring they have the right to download content.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
